Container.Name: heddohon
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: navidrome subsonic jellyfin music player flac lossless lyrics
Container.Overview:
A music player for a Navidrome, Subsonic or Jellyfin library, rendered on the server.
Audio and artwork are fetched by Heddohon rather than by the browser, so the music server never has to be reachable from the devices you play on: one hostname is exposed and the library stays where it is. Sign-in is a live call to the music server, so there is no second set of accounts to keep.
Streams the original file by default, with no transcoding or resampling, and shows what is being decoded. Transcoding to MP3, Opus or AAC is a setting, and the quality badge in the player switches it on and off mid-track for a connection that will not carry the original.
Synced lyrics, a tight track handoff, a server-side cover cache, and per-account settings and queue that follow you between devices.
Container.Description:
**Set before starting:**
- **HEDDOHON_SECRET** encrypts the music-server credentials Heddohon stores. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 48`. Changing it later signs everyone out. - **At least one music server URL.** These are resolved by the container, so a LAN address is the right answer: `http://192.168.1.10:4533`. - **ORIGIN**, if you reach this through a reverse proxy. It must be the public URL, or form submissions are refused by the CSRF origin check.
**Permissions:** the image runs unprivileged. This template runs it as 99:100 so it can write to appdata. If you remove that from Extra Parameters, run `chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/heddohon` first.
Full configuration: https://github.com/zorcerer/heddohon/blob/main/docs/configuration.md

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port the interface is served on.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Holds the SQLite database and the cover cache.

Config.Name: Secret
Config.Description: Encrypts stored music-server credentials and derives session keys. Minimum 32 characters: openssl rand -base64 48. Changing it signs everyone out.

Config.Name: Navidrome / Subsonic URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Navidrome or Subsonic server, resolved by this container rather than by the browser. Leave empty if you only use Jellyfin.

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Jellyfin server. Leave empty if you only use Navidrome.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address you reach Heddohon on, needed behind a reverse proxy for the CSRF origin check. For example https://music.example.com

Config.Name: Cover cache
Config.Description: Megabytes of cover art kept under the appdata path. The least recently used files are dropped once it is passed. 0 switches the cache off.

Config.Name: Session hours
Config.Description: How long a sign-in lasts. Capped at 72 whatever is set here, and never extended by activity.

Config.Name: Application name
Config.Description: Shown on the sign-in screen and in the sidebar.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: error, warn, info or debug. The default writes nothing while the server is working. debug times every call to the music server, for working out why a page is slow.

Config.Name: Secure cookie
Config.Description: auto marks the session cookie Secure. In this image that is always, whatever the scheme. Set false if you reach this over plain http on the LAN, or sign-in will not stick.

Config.Name: Navidrome label
Config.Description: Name shown for this server on the sign-in screen.

Config.Name: Jellyfin label
Config.Description: Name shown for this server on the sign-in screen.

Config.Name: Sign-in hint
Config.Description: An optional line of text on the sign-in screen, for telling users which account to use.

Config.Name: Upstream timeout
Config.Description: Milliseconds to wait on the music server before giving up.
